bullets.text: A 34-year-old woman named Nithyasree died after a private bus ran over her moped near Nazarethpet on Thursday, and the office should monitor road safety.
Officials in Tiruttani are reportedly denying 125 days of work to persons with disabilities under the rural employment scheme, and the district team should investigate.
A Panimalar Engineering College student from Poonamallee secured a 1.2 crore annual salary job at Meril Diagnostics, which the office should note for district achievements.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated 125 crore rupees in the first phase for AI assistive devices for persons with disabilities, and the portfolio team should track the rollout.

stories.title: Private bus runs over woman near Nazarethpet
takeaways: A 34-year-old woman named Nithyasree died when a private bus hit her moped near Nazarethpet on Thursday.
The fatal accident highlights urgent road safety concerns along the Vandalur-Minjur Outer Ring Road corridor.

stories.title: T.N. government to roll out scheme for AI assistive devices for persons with disability
takeaways: Tamil Nadu allocates Rs 125 crore in the first phase for AI assistive devices.
The scheme enables persons with disabilities to perform daily activities with modern technology.
